T: Cheese, crackers and one very suspicious penguin.
D: Wallace's helpful robot gnome goes rogue, and Gromit suspects an old feathered enemy is behind it.
P: Serve the cheese when Wallace calls for crackers.
S: Wensleydale and cheddar on toast, apple chutney and green apple

Thick toast topped with crumbly Wensleydale and a little cheddar, grilled until bubbling, finished with apple chutney and fresh apple slices. Toast 8 slices of thick white bread on one side under the grill. Turn and spread the untoasted sides lightly with butter. Crumble over 200g Wensleydale mixed with 80g grated cheddar, pressing it to the edges. Grill 3 to 4 minutes until bubbling and golden in spots. Top each with a spoon of apple chutney (150g total) and a few thin slices of green apple. Cut into triangles.
Egg-dipped bread fingers in cinnamon sugar, strawberry jam to dip

Thick bread fingers soaked in vanilla egg custard, fried golden in butter, rolled in cinnamon sugar and served with strawberry jam for dipping. Whisk 3 eggs with 150ml milk, 1 tbsp caster sugar and 1 tsp vanilla. Cut 6 thick slices of white bread into 3 fingers each. Dip each finger in the egg for a few seconds a side. Fry in batches in 40g butter over medium heat for 2 minutes a side until golden. Toss straight away in 50g caster sugar mixed with 1 tsp cinnamon. Serve warm with 150g strawberry jam.
Gromit's garden pea and courgette fritters

Grated courgette, peas, spring onion and feta in a light batter, fried in spoonfuls until golden, with a cool minted yoghurt dip. Grate 2 courgettes, squeeze out the liquid in a tea towel. Mix with 150g thawed peas, 2 sliced spring onions, 100g crumbled feta, 2 eggs, 100g self-raising flour and pepper. Heat 1cm oil in a frying pan over medium heat and fry heaped tablespoons for 2 to 3 minutes a side until golden. Drain on paper towel. Stir chopped mint and lemon juice into 200g Greek yoghurt for dipping.
M: Pork sausages on buttery mash with onion gravy
Pork sausages browned slowly in the pan, served on creamy buttered mash with a rich onion gravy poured over.
a hot pasty for a day in the garden shed

Golden shortcrust pasties crimped full of cheddar, diced potato and sweet onion with white pepper, served hot with brown pickle chutney. Heat the oven to 200C. Boil 300g diced potato for 6 minutes and drain. Soften 1 diced onion in 20g butter for 5 minutes. Mix the potato, onion, 200g grated cheddar, 1 tbsp chopped parsley and white pepper. Cut 4 shortcrust sheets into 20cm rounds. Spoon the filling onto one half, fold over, crimp the edges and brush with beaten egg. Bake 25 to 30 minutes until golden. Serve with pickle chutney.
W: Baked rolled pudding with strawberry jam and warm custard
Soft suet-style pastry spread with strawberry jam, rolled up, baked until golden and served in slices with hot custard.
K: Hot milk with chocolate, cocoa and malted milk powder

Rich hot chocolate made with melted milk chocolate, cocoa and malted milk powder, topped with whipped cream and a sprinkle of grated chocolate. Heat 1L milk in a saucepan until steaming. Whisk in 100g chopped milk chocolate, 2 tbsp cocoa, 3 tbsp malted milk powder and 1 tbsp sugar until smooth and frothy, about 3 minutes. Do not let it boil. Whip 150ml cream to soft peaks. Pour into 4 big mugs, spoon the cream on top and grate over a little more chocolate.
